scope: read-only diagnosis of own pilot; no packet capture or OS confinement claim
findings: Chromium 150 MappedHostResolver returns failing requests for ^NOTFOUND; ~NOTFOUND proceeds as hostname, confirmed by retained HOST_RESOLVER_MANAGER_REQUEST host http://~notfound.
The resolver performs IPv6 reachability probing even for the excluded literal loopback proxy.
Source probe connects UDP and checks its local address, without a Send call in that function. No packet capture was taken; this is not proof of all network behavior.
Revised owned LAB policy maps all hosts to ^NOTFOUND, including proxy, and requires the owned URL request to fail with ERR_PROXY_CONNECTION_FAILED before any observed TCP/UDP socket attempt.
